title: Zyahna Bryant
description: Bryant became a “Fat liberation” activist for Dove soap.
body:
# Zyahna Bryant

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/bryant-profile.png)

- Bryant became a “Fat liberation” **[activist](https://web.archive.org/web/20251007000720/https:/www.thecollegefix.com/uva-race-hoaxer-gets-deal-with-dove-as-fat-liberation-advocate/)** for Dove soap.

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/bryant-01.png)

- Black Lives Matter **[activist](https://web.archive.org/web/20241227120546/https:/momentum.medium.com/charlottesville-anti-racism-activist-zyahna-bryant-reimagines-race-and-space-b6351a7ef685)**
- Was **[accused](https://web.archive.org/web/20250917045501/https:/nypost.com/2023/04/29/blm-activist-ruined-white-university-of-virginia-students-rep/)** of getting a white student (who was the daughter of a police officer) expelled at UVA over “misheard” comments. Bryant tweeted this about the student: “EMAIL these UVA deans now to demand that Morgan face consequences for her actions and that UVA stop graduating racists.” The white student faced discipline by UVA but later **[settled](https://web.archive.org/web/20250901053822/https:/www.cavalierdaily.com/article/2024/02/u-va-alumna-settles-first-amendment-lawsuit-against-the-university-after-her-expulsion-in-abeyance)** in a first amendment lawsuit against the school.
- Advocates for **[redistribution of wealth](https://www.instagram.com/p/CfC8eH1Ok3z/?hl=en)** to black people.

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/bryant-04.png)

- Pushed for black students to “reclaim” their space at UVA.

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/bryant-05.png)

- The day after the Nov 2024 election she **[posted that](https://web.archive.org/web/20260323123908/https:/restoration-news.com/getmedia/15a443f8-f530-42c7-9875-73897d21eacc/Bryant-rage-is-sufficient.png)** “rage is sufficient”
- Advocated for “free Palestine” protests - **[called](https://web.archive.org/web/20260323124020/https:/restoration-news.com/getmedia/0b4e39f8-ffa8-473e-9801-56ef71083488/VA-Charl-Bryant-Police.png)** police presence concerning.
